notes.title: FIRST MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Dear Elves, 

We are happy to announce part of the changes we have implemented in A Very Bad Christmas Eve coming with today's update. 

(1)  Graphics overhaul and optimisation  

(2)  Manual  - we added an additional Game Manual in the Main Menu

(3)  Different Game Difficulties  - you can challenge yourself in “Terrible Elf”, “Bad Elf” and “Master Elf” Game Modes

(4)  Interactables  - almost everything is interactable

(5) Other small changes and (6) Bug fixes


 What is coming next? 

(1)  Up to three new Critical Machines  

(2)  Themed Rooms for every Critical Machine  

(3)  Leaderboards  

(4)  Achievements  

(5)  More Interactables  


Elves, let us know what do you think. Do you want us to implement some other features? 


We will be extremely happy and grateful to have you as a part of our inspiring community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480650/A_Very_Bad_Christmas_Eve/

We are social.
Keep up to date with A Very Bad Christmas Eve on our social media channels:

Incineration Productions Facebook
Incineration Productions Instagram
Incineration Productions Twitter
Incineration Productions Youtube

Best wishes and thank you for being part of our community,
Incineration Production’s Team

notes.title: You, guys, definitely RUINED Christmas!
notes.content:
Dear Elves, 

Merry Christmas! Be blessed and healthy and may all of your wishes come true! Thank you for buying A Very Bad Christmas Eve. We are happy to have you as a part of our inspiring community!

Guys, we love seeing your videos of how you are playing A Very Bad Christmas Eve on the Internet. Thank you for showing our game and sharing your feedback.

Today, we decided to share some of our favourite gameplay videos. And, Fellows, you might find it strange, but in most of them you will see how people are breaking our game. Yep, those players totally ruined Christmas, but we almost died laughing. So… Happy Holidays, elves. You better try to save Christmas again! Unless you want to stay on the naughty list until next Christmas...

Discounted Price till Jan 5, 2021 @ 10:00 am Pacific

You can now support us by buying A Very Bad Christmas Eve at a special discounted price of 40% which will be valid till Jan 5, 2021 @ 10:00 am Pacific.

We will be extremely happy and grateful to have you as a part of our inspiring community!

What is coming next?
In the coming months we have plans to make A Very Bad Christmas Eve even more stalwart with the implementation of some features, which we came up with while watching you playing it. Although those features are already planned out in our development cycle, we are willing to also implement features which came from you, guys, our amazing community. Don't hesitate to share your suggestions.

Best wishes and thank you for being part of our community,
Incineration Production’s Team
